decision.summary: Tenant offered £100/month toward £3,700 arrears but a Breathing Space has applied since 01/10/2026. I paused arrears contact, informed the adviser and landlord, noted the record and escalated to legal, mainly to stop the scheduled SMS and Section 8 draft.

answers.question: What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space (from 01/10/2026). We cannot contact the tenant about the arrears (go through adviser Ruth Okoye), take enforcement action, or serve arrears-ground notices such as Section 8 Ground 8. Current rent and repair contact continue.

answers.question: Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No. Agreeing payment plans needs human and landlord authority. It has been escalated, and any reply will go via the adviser.

answers.question: What actions and communications do you make, to whom?
answers.answer: Emailed the debt adviser (A1), emailed the landlord (A2), added a note to the tenant record to cancel the 12/10 SMS and 14/10 Section 8 draft (A3), and escalated to legal P2 (A4). I did not message the tenant about the arrears.

conflicts: Scheduled arrears SMS and Section 8 draft conflict with the Breathing Space; the notice was trusted.
